namespace: "Query"
description: "Query cells from a CellxGene Census or custom TileDBSoma object. Aside from fetching the cells' RNA counts (`.X`), cell metadata (`.obs`) and gene metadata (`.var`), this component also fetches the dataset metadata and joins it into the cell metadata."

## Argument groups

### Input database

Open CellxGene Census by version or URI.

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="columnheader"}
Description
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="columnheader"}
Attributes
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--input_uri`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
If specified, a URI containing the Census SOMA objects. If specified, will take precedence over the `--census_version` argument.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"s3://bucket/path"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--census_version`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Which release of CellxGene census to use. Possible values are "latest", "stable", or the date of one of the releases (e.g. "2023-07-25"). For more information, check the documentation on [Census data releases](https://chanzuckerberg.github.io/cellxgene-census/cellxgene_census_docsite_data_release_info.html).
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"stable"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--add_dataset_metadata`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
If true, the experiment metadata will be added to the cell metadata. More specifically: `collection_id`, `collection_name`, `collection_doi`, `dataset_title`.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::::

### Cell query

Arguments related to the query.

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="columnheader"}
Description
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="columnheader"}
Attributes
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--species`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The organism to query, usually one of `Homo sapiens` or `Mus musculus`.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"homo_sapiens"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--obs_value_filter`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Filter for selecting the `obs` metadata (i.e. cells). Value is a filter query written in the SOMA `value_filter` syntax.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"is_primary_data == True and cell_type_ontology_term_id in ['CL:0000136', 'CL:1000311', 'CL:0002616'] and suspension_type == 'cell'"`
:::
::::
:::::

### Filter cells by grouping

Filter groups with fewer than X number of cells.

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="columnheader"}
Description
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="columnheader"}
Attributes
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--cell_filter_grouping`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
A subset of 'obs' columns by which to group the cells for filtering.
Only groups surpassing or equal to the `--cell_filter_minimum_count`
threshold will be retained. Take care not to introduce a selection
bias against cells with more fine-grained ontology annotations.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"dataset_id"`, `"tissue"`, `"assay"`, `"disease"`, `"cell_type"`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--cell_filter_minimum_count`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
A minimum number of cells per group to retain. If `--cell_filter_grouping`
is defined, this parameter should also be provided and vice versa.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Example]{.arg-key} `100`
:::
::::
:::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/query/cellxgene_census/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/query/cellxgene_census);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/query/cellxgene_census/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
